Infinite domain is supported by proof, not experiment.

value.rationale: This exact initially recurrent-state population is a natural invariant of synchronous excitation on a connected dense bipartite family. The deletion of the full perfect matching causes nontrivial local phase-exclusion constraints and an isolated n=4 permutation class; the theorem classifies all phase supports and yields exact counts at every family size. It is not a simple restatement of the general activity theorem, and does not claim other period classes.
